title: Community Fee at Move-In (Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement)
content:
The community fee of the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement is charged once at move-in, at the community fee of the rate card.

- Where the rate card waives the community fee for an internal transfer, a resident whose admission source is Larkspur independent living pays no community fee, and no community fee charge is posted.
- A resident converting from a Larkspur respite stay is charged the community fee and receives the respite conversion credit instead.
- The community fee may be charged only while the residency is in active status.

### Admission source and community fee (illustration)

| Admission source | Community fee charged at move-in | Respite conversion credit |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur independent living (waiver in place on the rate card) | No | — |
| Larkspur respite stay | Yes | Yes |
| Any other admission source | Yes | — |

**Status.** A residency still in pending admission status cannot carry the community fee; the fee is charged once the residency is active, that is from move-in.
